lastCompletedStory.title: Halt the supervisor inner story loop cooperatively when the pause marker is set

nextStoryContext: RunSupervisorOptions gained an optional isPaused?: () => boolean (loop.ts), consulted as the literal FIRST statement inside runSupervisor's `outer: while` loop, before readPrd()/decideNextAction/any dispatch. When it returns true the function returns { status: 'paused', iterations, lastOutcome } immediately WITHOUT calling finishTerminal -- no teardownWorkerPaneFn, no implement-blocked-marker writes, no onProgress terminal emission. SupervisorStatus gained 'paused' as a 5th member of the union; TERMINAL_REASON (Record<SupervisorStatus,string>) got a harmless 'paused: paused' entry purely to satisfy the exhaustive-Record type (it is never read at runtime since finishTerminal is never called on the paused path). Production wiring: buildSupervisorOptions (host.ts) sets isPaused: () => isPauseSet(claudeDir), importing isPauseSet from src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts (US-001). Resume needs no special plumbing: runSupervisor always treats prd.json as the sole source of truth per invocation, so once `cam resume` clears the marker, the next runSupervisor call just re-reads prd.json and dispatches whatever is still passes:false -- proven by test/supervisor/pause-resume.test.ts. NOT wired in this story (explicitly out of scope per the AC list): the outer runSidecarLoop (loop.ts ~2164-2505) does not special-case result.status === 'paused' -- it falls through the same opts.clearActive() + sleep(idlePollMs) path every other terminal status takes, so a paused halt still flips active:false and the sidecar idles (consistent with 'graceful brake' semantics) but there is no dedicated 'paused' narration line to the orchestrator pane and no explicit cam-worker-events.jsonl 'sidecar-exit' entry for the pause case (finishTerminal, which emits that event, is deliberately skipped). If a future story wants pause-specific sidecar narration or an event-log trace, that is new scope. File-size ceilings were raised for both touched files (host.ts 1124->1128, loop.ts 2506->2546) in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref note citing CAM-360/US-002; both changes are staged.
